data.text:
Viction’s growth in May 2025 says a lot about where the ecosystem is heading.

From new integrations to creative contests, user activity, and regional expansion — here’s a simple breakdown of what happened and why it matters 🧵

---

@starbasetg now supports Viction.

Users can buy Telegram Stars using $VIC and $C98.

This brings Viction closer to Telegram’s huge user base — and gives $VIC more real-world utility.

---

@goldskyio joined the ecosystem.

They brought powerful developer tools like real-time indexing and subgraph support.

This makes it much easier to build on Viction — and keep things running fast and reliably.

---

@ViktoBot launched its token.

$VIKTO went live via Starship and hit 7,000+ users in 10 days.
It shows real demand for DeFi tools built on Viction’s fast, zero-gas infrastructure.

There’s also a $100K $VIKTO trading competition live until August 27.

---

$CARROT launched — and brought memes with it.

Carrot x Rabbit rolled out the token and ran a meme contest that lit up RabbitSwap.

Fun, creative, and community-first — a reminder that Viction supports both serious tools and playful culture.

---

NFT creators got the spotlight.

A $2,500 prize pool was launched to support NFT collection builders — backed by ArtNodeSociety, TheTwentyStudio, and more.

It’s a solid step toward building Viction’s creative layer.

---

@rabbitswapxyz added a full portfolio dashboard.

Now users can track balances, liquidity, net worth, and history in one view.

Simple but impactful — and good for anyone active in DeFi.

---

Numbers worth noting:
— 139.7K monthly active wallets
— $11.7M total value locked across DeFi
— $12.8M in lifetime RabbitSwap volume
— $2.2M RabbitSwap TVL peak (May)

---

VIP#4 got approved.

97% of the community voted YES to allocate 5M $VIC toward ecosystem growth.
That means more resources for core strategy, marketing, and grassroots support — through the rest of 2025.

---

Viction Philippines officially launched.

This is a major step in Southeast Asia.

It brings local support, partnerships (like https://t.co/Psn1YK36iM & @Frontier_DAO), and real on-the-ground energy to the ecosystem.

---

That’s May 2025 for Viction.
Consistent growth, more tools, more users — and clearer signals of where things are goin

Catch the full breakdown here: https://t.co/MstcMIZDFv 

@BuildOnViction @VictionEco

[✨] MIXX LAB IN MANILA

NSWERs! To coincide with the release of NMIXX's DAY MIXX featuring MIXX LAB in Manila, we're sharing with everyone the post-event transparency report 📝

To begin with, a total of ₱12,249 was generously donated—thank you so much! 🙏
Photos below show the total donation received, all the proposed fan projects with the blue texts as the accepted projects, and the organizer's message with regards to NMIXX's and JjyuKyu's cakes. 

About the cakes, we would also like to take this time to clarify and reassure everyone that, while not featured in the photo and video, the cakes for NMIXX and JjyuKyu were made and delivered to the organizer, who confirmed their delivery to NMIXX's team. 

We also don't have any idea what happened with the cakes after handing them to the organizer especially since the cakes were not posted in both photos and videos taken during the fan concert. Hopefully, we can see or hear something about the cakes from SQUAD.

Cakes aside, we thank every NSWER a lot for all your support and again, for making MIXX LAB in Manila a total success. Let's aim for more the next time! Thank you again, PH NSWERs!! 💓

A full breakdown of the expenses and project photos and video can be accessed via this link:
🔗: https://t.co/0vOtnw1OhL
